Name: Ancient Fruit Price Increase and Grow All Season
Author: art107
Description:
I'm doing a playthrough with mods that makes starfruit regrow and sweet gem berries artisan products so I made this mod to make Ancient Fruit more "viable". This mod makes Ancient Fruit grow all seasons and increase its price to 600g (configurable). The price increase do affect ancient fruit jelly and wine. You can choose whether to enable or disable the all seasons grow and the price changes.

Config:
FruitPrices: 600, 650, 750, false (Default: 600)
AllSeasonGrow: true, false (Default: true)

You can change these setting in game with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]

Compatibility: 
- Stardew Valley 1.6+
- Should be Compatible with most mods
- Compatible with mods that changes ancient fruit textures
- Compatible with mods that makes quality artisan products such as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21720?tab=description]Machine Progression System[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21278]Artisan Goods Keep Quality[/url]﻿
- Not compatible with mods that changes ancient fruit price & growth
